name: Stationary engine fan housing, AlSi10Mg F0 concept
description: Independent concept of a 993 annular housing combining shell, front flange, alternator support and six spokes. The sources establish the part number, a commercial envelope, two consistent masses and a reseller claim of aluminum, but no interface geometry; the F0 does not reproduce the Porsche part.

classification.intended_use: F0 screening of open CAD, DfAM value, flow, pressure loss, bending, modal, thermal and mass; no manufacturing, installation, fan rotation or engine start-up authorized

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, illustration, Porsche/PorscheFanatics/FVD/Centre Porsche Roissy/CarParts/EOS surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - 993 engine fan housing and airflow
sources.notes: Establishes the role of the housing in air distribution and the 993 context, without geometry or material. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-FAN-HOUSING-CANDIDATE.

sources.title: FVD Brombacher - housing 993 106 667 03
sources.notes: Publishes 300 x 300 x 170 mm and 1.9 kg as product data; no interface and no material. See SRC-FVD-993-FAN-HOUSING-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: Centre Porsche Roissy - blower housing 993 106 667 03
sources.notes: Links 993 106 667 03/01 and publishes 1.86 kg, without protocol. See SRC-PORSCHE-ROISSY-993-FAN-HOUSING-MASS.

sources.title: CarParts - 993 housing declared aluminum
sources.notes: Declares aluminum without grade, process or certificate; does not prove AlSi10Mg. See SRC-CARPARTS-993-FAN-HOUSING-ALUMINIUM.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg material data sheet
sources.notes: T6 route and candidate material; numerical values kept as generic comparisons. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-CURRENT-PAGE.

material.grade: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg T6 for comparison; commercial replacement declared only as unspecified aluminum
material.standard: DIN EN 1706 EN AC-43000 and ASTM F3318 for the candidate; program-specific cooling, fatigue and containment specification to be contracted

post_processing: orientation and supports of the 300 x 300 x 170 mm ring to be qualified
stress relief then T6 with monitored quench and distortion
HIP to be decided on fatigue, air tightness and tomography results
machining of the fan bore, alternator seat, mounting, seal and datums
deburring, open depowdering and particle-free duct finishing
anti-corrosion treatment compatible with temperatures, fasteners and engine compartment
final clearance check before any rotation
supplier_requirements: traceable large-platform machine, parameters, orientation, supports, powder and lot
oriented coupons with tensile, fatigue, creep and hot corrosion
witness samples for annular distortion and duct surface finish
full CT, FPI and metallography with zoned defect criteria
metrology of bore, concentricity, alternator, mountings, seal and envelope
evidence of flow, vibration, overspeed/containment, thermal cycling and engine endurance

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify AlSi10Mg against alternator, bearings, bolts, engine and sheet metal; address corrosion, fretting and differential expansion.

known_limits: The 300 x 300 x 170 mm figures are a commercial envelope, not a definition drawing.
The 1.86/1.9 kg masses are commercial claims with no protocol and no weighing boundary.
The aluminum material comes with no grade, no process and no certificate; AlSi10Mg remains a candidate.
The 252 mm diameter, 3 mm shell, 4 mm flange, hub, six spokes and mountings are synthetic.
The flow, loss, load, speed, blade count and temperature cases are regressions with no 993 authority.
The constrained thermal screen fails; fatigue, containment and cooling remain non-computable.
No CFD/CHT, converged FEA, correlated modal, overspeed, vibration or endurance is demonstrated.
The STEP proves only a re-readable BREP; no manufacturing, rotation or start-up is authorized.
